thread:
Ashley: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need concrete owners and dates for the vendor mitigation items (cloud auth, model-registry mirror, and provider failover tests). I put an initial list in the PM board.

Jordan: Thanks — can we avoid open-ended 'platform' ownership? prefer named people or rotation.

Leo: +1. Proposal: assign primary + secondary for each item, and a quarterly rotation owner for long-running work. That lets us surface drift.

Sam: I created a tiny runbook for the auth fallback we tested. Pasting here for visibility: 
```
# auth fallback snippet (pseudo)
if provider_auth_fail:
  switch_to_cached_tokens()
  route_requests(region="us-west-2")
  notify(oncall, severity="high")
```
Use as a starting point for the playbook.

Mia: Who will run the first end-to-end failover drill for cloud provider auth? We should schedule a non-prod run and a low-risk prod rehearsal.

Ashley: Assigning: Sam (primary) / Leo (backup) to own auth fallback cookbook + drill scheduling. Target: first non-prod drill by 2026-04-08, prod rehearsal by 2026-04-22.

Jordan: Noted. I'll add calendar invites and include runbook verification checklist.

Sam: For model-registry availability, proposal: maintain a read-only mirror in a second region + health-check webhook that triggers a degraded-mode route. Owner: Mia (primary) / Jordan (backup). Timeline: mirror up by 2026-04-15.

Mia: I'll pick this up. Need infra quota confirmation from infra team — @leo can you confirm GPU/storage quotas in the mirror region?

Leo: Confirmed on quotas for staging mirror; prod quotas pending (submitted request ticket INF-4721).

incident-bot: Created ticket INC-2026-043: "Auth fallback playbook + drills" (owner: sam).

devex-bot: Created ticket INF-4721 referenced by thread.

Ashley: Action tracker summary (I'll own the board):
- Auth fallback playbook: owner sam, backup leo, non-prod drill 2026-04-08, prod rehearsal 2026-04-22.
- Model-registry mirror: owner mia, backup jordan, mirror live 2026-04-15 (blocked by INF-4721).
- SLA & provider test cadence: owner leo, create monthly synthetic tests across auth/model-registry by 2026-04-30.
- Recurring incident pattern review: owner ashley, run weekly for 6 weeks, report back 2026-05-20.

Jordan: Can we add an explicit verification metric for each item? e.g., model-registry: replica lag < 5s, auth: cached-token failover latency < 150ms.

Mia: Agree. I'll draft the SLA checks and add them to the board.

Sam: I'll add a checklist to the runbook to validate the failover path end-to-end (auth, token refresh, KV cache warmup).

Ashley: Please update the tickets with clear acceptance criteria and test steps. I'll run weekly follow-ups on Monday standups until all items are closed or re-scoped.

Leo: One more ask — add a 'owner drift' alert: if a mitigation ticket has no owner change in 30 days but no activity, flag product-ops. Might help avoid future drift.

Jordan: I'll add that automation to the board (owner drift rule).

incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: Monday 2026-03-30 09:15 UTC — "Vendor mitigations standup" (channel: #incidents).

Ashley: Thanks everyone. I'll post the updated action tracker link when I finish adding Jira IDs. :thumbsup:

Sam: Added initial acceptance criteria to INC-2026-043.

Mia: Added SLA metrics draft to the board.

Leo: INF-4721 updated with estimated quota delivery 2026-04-06.

Ashley: Closing this thread for now — will reopen in the standup if anything slips.
